# "random k" after an id: the case passes with k of the 8 seed variants.
# "sample-only" after an id: every expectation the case compares is a sample
# that matched, so it is evidence of the rule, not of an exact value; "sample-only k":
# so on k seeds, with every sample missing on the others.
